about: Example only: not a bots.json, and the bot never reads this file. Proposed per-bot models, not evaluated and not applied; see docs/MODEL-QUALITY.md first.
apply: By hand, in the data directory's bots.json: for each id below, set only the "model" field of the entry with that id; null means that entry keeps no "model" field. Leave id, name, aliases, prefix, default, role and subagent as they are.

why.chief: The default bot: it answers every message without an @, and @all. It plans, routes and merges every result the user reads. Its subagents, research-role ones included, run on its model, so they cost more too.
why.research: Read-only lookups and summaries for tasks routed to research, such as a message that starts with @研究 or @research. Pinned to the cheaper model, so it stays there if the orchestrator default changes.
why.eng: Edits, tests and git, where a wrong step costs more than tokens. Its subagents run on its model too.
why.ops: Omitted rather than pinned to the same model: it runs on the orchestrator agent's model, oneapi/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash when this was written, with no second copy to keep in sync. Revisit if case 4 of the evaluation fails on the default model.
